nameInUI: Smart threat reaction (only the targeted flight evades)
descriptionInUI: Only the flight a missile is actually guiding on goes defensive. Every other airplane stays on Passive Defense and keeps flying its route, where stock DCS breaks every jet that sees a launch. A missile is followed until it is gone, so a late lock or a switch to another flight moves the defense with it. A flight facing a missile whose target DCS never reports flies straight instead of breaking. Helicopters keep stock behavior. Untick for stock DCS.

specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Off by default. On, defensive orders also print to the screen for all players, at most once every 15 seconds. Orders, failures and a once-a-minute summary go to dcs.log either way, rate-limited.
